articles.title: Military Digest | A look at Indian Army’s role in Persia in the 2 World Wars
articles.summary: The article discusses the extensive history of Persian invasions of India, spanning from Darius's 6th-century BCE forays to Nader Shah's 18th-century battles. Despite detailed coverage in school curricula, it highlights a perceived lack of deeper public knowledge or understanding of these profound historical interactions, which significantly shaped the Indian subcontinent.
